protocol.comparison: Exact encoded text within declared namespace; keep asterisks, damage, and boundaries unchanged
protocol.mayig_formatting: Remove P prefix from exactly Pddd tokens and wrap with +/hyphens; no numeric crosswalk, reversal, or sorting
protocol.duplicates_mean: Repeated encoded sequences, not demonstrated duplicate artifacts
protocol.independence_limit: Same underlying artifacts may overlap across corpora; distinct rows and source labels do not establish independent observations

_citation.derivation: ICIT-format diplomatic sequence export for Indus corpus reconstruction. Sequences use ICIT encoding rules: +NNN-NNN+, 000, ++. See CITATIONS.md sections A.1, A.7, I.1–I.5.

icit_target_scale.note: ICIT reference scale from public ICIT documentation.

m77_frequency_diagnostic.interpretation: Diagnostic within the source-claimed M77 namespace, not a crosswalk or authentication. Asterisk meanings and damage conventions are not established here. Subset selection can reduce totals; counts above the primary table flag a nonliteral-subset relationship or differences in convention, counting, or transcription. No exact-match expectation.

m77_object_identity.assessment: Export has unique Glossa row identifiers, some embedding an M77-like numeric reference, but no explicit original reference, excavation number, artifact/side link, image, or per-row citation. Stability across releases and original-source identity cannot be established from this snapshot.

upstream_tree.limitation: Tree records file paths and hashes, not un-downloaded file contents; no ingest code or canonical object-level lineage has been inspected here

conclusion: Public export is labelled a mixed mayig/Mahadevan reconstruction, not identified as the private 1670-object Holdat corpus. Its 179 mayig text rows reproduce the existing raw mayig multiset exactly. M77 extraction lineage and artifact overlaps remain unauthenticated; retain this component as a provisional avenue for primary transcription checks, not an adopted corpus. ICIT-format syntax does not make these Wells/ICIT sign numbers or an official ICIT corpus.
